"""Export exact paired ES-01-008 masters without stretching geometry."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageOps
import argparse, hashlib, json, shutil

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("source", type=Path)
args = ap.parse_args()
p = Path(__file__).parent
record = json.loads((p / "conditions.json").read_text())
assert record["generation_allowed"]
out = p / "masters"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
src = Image.open(args.source).convert("RGB")
shutil.copy2(args.source, p / "source-final.png")
checks = []

for fmt, size in [("16x9", (1920, 1080)), ("4x5", (864, 1080))]:
    # ImageOps.fit crops only; it never stretches. The source is a 16:9 outpaint
    # of the same scene, with the full tower deliberately centered for portrait.
    frame = ImageOps.fit(src, size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS, centering=(0.5, 0.5)).convert("RGBA")
    w, h = size
    scrim = Image.new("RGBA", size)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(scrim)
    start = round(h * .80)
    for y in range(start, h):
        alpha = round(188 * ((y - start) / (h - start)) ** 1.3)
        draw.line((0, y, w, y), fill=(0, 0, 0, alpha))
    frame = Image.alpha_composite(frame, scrim)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(frame)
    font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
    labels = [
        ("Guggenheim Museum, Bilbao", .016),
        ("Scenario: " + record["scenario_label"], .012),
        ("AI-generated artistic interpretation · Not a photograph.", .010),
    ]
    fonts = [ImageFont.truetype(font_path, round(w * frac)) for _, frac in labels]
    heights = [draw.textbbox((0, 0), s, font=f)[3] for (s, _), f in zip(labels, fonts)]
    pad = round(w * .025)
    bottom = h - round(h * .026)
    gap = round(w * .007)
    y = bottom - sum(heights) - 2 * gap
    boxes = []
    for (s, _), f, ht in zip(labels, fonts, heights):
        box = draw.textbbox((pad, y), s, font=f)
        boxes.append(box)
        draw.text((pad, y), s, font=f, fill="white")
        y += ht + gap
    sigfont = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, round(w * .018))
    sigbox = draw.textbbox((w - pad, bottom), "Jason D’s Vision", font=sigfont, anchor="rs")
    draw.text((w - pad, bottom), "Jason D’s Vision", font=sigfont, fill="white", anchor="rs")
    assert all(b[0] >= 0 and b[2] <= w and b[1] >= 0 and b[3] <= h for b in boxes + [sigbox])
    assert boxes[-1][2] < sigbox[0], "Disclosure/signature collision"
    target = out / f"es-01-010-r2-{fmt}.png"
    assert not target.exists(), "Preserve any existing master; do not overwrite"
    frame.convert("RGB").save(target, format="PNG", compress_level=6)
    actual = Image.open(target)
    actual.load()
    assert actual.size == size and actual.format == "PNG"
    checks.append({
        "file": str(target),
        "dimensions": list(actual.size),
        "format": actual.format,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "source_dimensions": list(src.size),
        "labels": [s for s, _ in labels],
        "signature": "Jason D’s Vision",
        "font_pixels": [round(w * f) for _, f in labels] + [round(w * .018)],
        "text_boxes": boxes,
        "signature_box": sigbox,
        "lineage": "uniform Lanczos resampling and crop from one 16:9 built-in source from the built-in generated source; corrections documented in prompts; deterministic gradient/text",
        "visual_inspection": "pending",
    })

(p / "export-checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps(checks, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

"""Archive fresh ES-01-010 scenario evidence and compute the lighting stage."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json, math, urllib.request

p = Path(__file__).parent
lat_deg, lon_deg = 43.2692, -2.9337
url = (
    "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=43.2692&longitude=-2.9337"
    "&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,cloud_cover,is_day,precipitation,wind_speed_10m"
    "&daily=sunrise,sunset&timezone=Europe%2FMadrid&forecast_days=1"
)
raw = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=40).read()
data = json.loads(raw)
t = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
local = t.astimezone(ZoneInfo("Europe/Madrid"))
g = 2 * math.pi / 365 * (t.timetuple().tm_yday - 1 + (t.hour - 12) / 24)
eq = 229.18 * (
    .000075 + .001868 * math.cos(g) - .032077 * math.sin(g)
    - .014615 * math.cos(2 * g) - .040849 * math.sin(2 * g)
)
dec = (
    .006918 - .399912 * math.cos(g) + .070257 * math.sin(g)
    - .006758 * math.cos(2 * g) + .000907 * math.sin(2 * g)
    - .002697 * math.cos(3 * g) + .00148 * math.sin(3 * g)
)
h = math.radians((t.hour * 60 + t.minute + t.second / 60 + eq + 4 * lon_deg) / 4 - 180)
lat = math.radians(lat_deg)
alt = math.degrees(math.asin(math.sin(lat) * math.sin(dec) + math.cos(lat) * math.cos(dec) * math.cos(h)))
az = (math.degrees(math.atan2(math.sin(h), math.cos(h) * math.sin(lat) - math.tan(dec) * math.cos(lat))) + 180) % 360
sunrise = datetime.fromisoformat(data["daily"]["sunrise"][0]).replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Europe/Madrid"))
sunset = datetime.fromisoformat(data["daily"]["sunset"][0]).replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Europe/Madrid"))
if sunrise - timedelta(minutes=45) <= local < sunrise:
    stage = "DAWN twilight"
elif sunrise <= local < sunset:
    stage = "Daylight"
elif sunset <= local <= sunset + timedelta(minutes=45):
    stage = "DUSK twilight"
else:
    stage = "Night"
record = {
    "retrieved_utc": t.isoformat(),
    "retrieved_local": local.isoformat(),
    "provider_url": url,
    "response": data,
    "scenario_label": local.strftime("%d %B %Y · %H:%M Europe/Madrid"),
    "requested_coordinates": [lat_deg, lon_deg],
    "model_grid_coordinates": [data["latitude"], data["longitude"]],
    "grid_resolution": "not provided in response; coordinate offset is not resolution",
    "solar": {
        "method": "NOAA fractional-year geometric approximation, not observation",
        "elevation_deg": round(alt, 2),
        "azimuth_deg": round(az, 2),
    },
    "lighting_stage": stage,
    "sunrise_local": sunrise.isoformat(),
    "sunset_local": sunset.isoformat(),
    "twilight_window_minutes": 45,
    "generation_allowed": stage in ["Daylight", "DUSK twilight", "DAWN twilight"],
    "disclaimer": "Model data from Open-Meteo; not a verified on-site observation.",
}
stamp = local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
(p / f"preflight-{stamp}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
(p / f"open-meteo-raw-{stamp}.json").write_bytes(raw)
(p / "conditions.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if record["generation_allowed"] else 2)
